_doc: Interface art for the pattern skirmish (2026-11-21): a painted backdrop behind the board, a crest for the title, and one gem per element replacing the emoji. Generated by tools/asset_gen/gen_sprites.py --spec pattern_ui.json --out prototypes/pattern-skirmish/art. Same chibi cartoon look as the champion sprites; prompts never name another game.
styleCharacter: Cute cartoon mobile-game character sprite in a chibi style: oversized head about a third of the total height, short stubby body and limbs, big expressive eyes, thick dark brown outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one soft highlight, bright saturated colours, a bold readable silhouette with one clear main colour. Seen in three-quarter front view from slightly above, as if on an isometric game board, standing in a confident idle pose holding its weapon, full body with feet visible, centred, filling about 80% of the image height. One character only. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, no border, no scenery.
styleStructure: Cute cartoon mobile-game interface icon: a chunky faceted gemstone, thick dark brown outline, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one bright highlight, saturated colours, seen straight from the front, centred, filling about 80% of the image. One object only. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, no border, no scenery.
background: The background is one perfectly flat, uniform solid {bgName} colour ({bgHex}) filling the whole image edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette and no texture. Do not use {bgName} anywhere on the subject.
referenceNote: Match the art style of the reference image exactly: the same outline thickness, the same shading, the same chibi proportions, the same camera angle and the same level of detail. Draw a completely different character, described here:

assets.prompt: A wide painted background for a cute cartoon fantasy strategy game, seen from slightly above: a magical twilight valley with a round stone arena plateau in the middle distance, soft misty pine forests on both sides, distant snowy mountains, floating glowing crystals and fireflies, a deep indigo and teal evening sky with warm golden light near the horizon. Hand-painted, soft, slightly blurred, low contrast and fairly dark so that game pieces placed on top stand out; the centre is calm and empty. No characters, no creatures, no text, no logo, no user interface, no border.

assets.subject: A heraldic crest emblem for a fantasy game called Augury: a round gold medallion with a glowing violet all-seeing eye in the middle, small blue and red gems on the left and right sides, two crossed silver spears behind it. No letters.
A fire element gem: a glowing orange-red teardrop ruby with a tiny flame shape inside.
A frost element gem: a pale icy blue diamond crystal with a tiny snowflake shape inside.
An earth element gem: a rounded warm brown and moss-green amber stone with a tiny leaf and rock shape inside.
A storm element gem: a bright violet amethyst crystal with a tiny yellow lightning bolt inside.
A light element gem: a radiant golden-yellow topaz star-cut gem with a tiny shining sun inside.
A shadow element gem: a deep dark purple-black onyx crescent-moon shaped gem with a faint purple glow.
